items.title: governance.yml schema overstates current architectural root role
items.current_text_claim: All downstream kernels, CI gates, and eval harnesses derive from this file.
items.finding: Observed usage supports a synthetic/legacy governance-role schema and evaluation surface, not a demonstrated current root for all K1-K8 kernels or CI gates.
items.risk: Current-facing readers may infer a second or older architecture authority root that conflicts with the canonical K1-K8 ownership model.
items.recommended_disposition: Narrow the schema description and any dependent documentation to its actual conformance/evaluation scope unless additional live derivation evidence is found.
items.resolution: The schema description now identifies governance.yml.schema.json as a versioned JSON Schema used by repository conformance/evaluation surfaces, notes the closed-object validation semantics represented by additionalProperties=false, and explicitly states that the schema is not the architectural root of all DGAF kernels or CI gates.
